data.title: 鸣濑白羽 · 老屋榻榻米上的初次袒露
data.description: 海风吹拂着老旧和室的风铃。白羽咬着自己的银白发丝侧躺在席上，单薄的纯白睡衣被推至腰际，纤弱的锁骨与腹部剧烈起伏，任由灼热的手掌寸寸探索。
data.location: traditional seaside Japanese tatami room with open sliding doors to evening garden
data.action: 白羽咬着自己的银白发丝侧躺在席上，单薄的纯白睡衣被推至腰际，纤弱的锁骨与腹部剧烈起伏
data.lighting: soft moonlight filtering through bamboo blinds mixed with faint wind chime tinkling
data.promptProse: Lying on her side across the woven tatami of an old seaside Japanese room with sliding doors open to the night breeze, Shiroha bites a stray lock of her silver-white hair to quiet her uneven breathing. Her semi-sheer white lace-trimmed camisole is pushed up to her bust above frilled shorts as warm hands trace slowly across her bare midriff and waist, bringing tears and a deep flush to her cheeks. Cool moonlight filters through bamboo blinds into the quiet room.
data.animaCaption: Lying on her side on the tatami mat with her sheer white sleep camisole pushed up above her waist, Shiroha bites a strand of hair with teary, flushed eyes as her partner's hands caress her bare midriff. Soft moonlight filters through bamboo blinds across the quiet room.
data.nsfwProse: Her semi-sheer white cotton-gauze sleep camisole is pushed up toward her chest above frilled sleep shorts, leaving her shoulders and trembling midriff bare beneath her partner's caressing hands.
